0022600144.text: Cleveland arrives at 3-1 on a three-game win streak, sitting second in the Central, half a game back, and fifth in the East, while Atlanta is 2-3, has lost three straight, and ranks seventh in the East. Cleveland's Jaylon Tyson (neck) and Meleek Thomas (foot) are both listed as day-to-day and are game-time decisions, while Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), who are both out. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27 after splitting their 2025-26 series 2-2, and their last meeting, on April 10 in Atlanta, ended with the Cavaliers losing 124-102.
